newsitem.title: UK: Budget deficits don't create jobs - France's Juppe.
newsitem.headline: Budget deficits don't create jobs - France's Juppe.

text.p: French Prime Minister Alain Juppe, acknowledging Britain's success in reducing unemployment, said on Monday that the way for France to create jobs was to get its public finances in order.
Speaking to reporters after talks with British Prime Minister John Major, Juppe said France was making "interesting progress" toward reining in its budget deficit.
Unemployment had fallen in December and the health of French companies, especially small firms, was looking up, he added.
Asked whether Major had passed on any economic tips over lunch, Juppe said diplomatically that he was aware of Britain's employment record but that France would follow its own policies.
"I'd like to stress in particular the fact that it's not deficits that create jobs. Perhaps Great Britain has already shown to be the case," he said.
